account.guest_welcome: You are signed in as a guest. Your access is limited to the surfaces the admin has allowed, for the window they set.

account.delete_confirm_dialog: Delete your account permanently? This cannot be undone.

account.flash_cancelled: Your account deletion has been cancelled. Your account is still active.
